lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Alas, and did my Savior bleed?
And did my Sovereign die?
Would He devote that sacred hand for such a worm as I?
Was it for sins that I had done?
He groaned upon the tree
Amazing pity, grace unknown,
And love beyond degree
At the cross, at the cross where I first saw the light And

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: The burden of my heart rolled away It
Was there by faith I received my sight And
Now I am happy all the day

lines: Well might the sun in darkness hide
And shut his glories in When
Christ the mighty maker died For
Man his creature sent
The smile to hide my blushing face While his dear cross appears
Dissolve my heart in thankfulness
And melt mine eyes to tears at
The cross, at the cross where

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: I first saw the light and
The burden of my heart rolled away it
Was there by faith
I received my sight And
Now I am happy all the day

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: But drops of grief can ne'er repay

Tis all that I can do

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: At the cross, at the cross Where
